findings.issue: はこ (箱, 'box') was misparsed as the topic particle: kana has このわこの instead of このはこの (the は is the 2nd mora of はこ, read HA). Also standalone 中 'the inside' transcribed ちゅう instead of なか. Two wrong readings in the phonetic line.
findings.current: このわこのそとわみどりだがちゅうわあかである。
findings.suggested: このはこのそとわみどりだがなかわあかである。

findings.issue: Mirrors the kana errors: 'konowakono' should be 'konohakono' (はこ = 箱 'box', not particle wa) and 'chuu' should be 'naka' (bare noun 中 = なか).

Missegmentation: このはこの = この箱(はこ)の 'of this box'. This は token is the 2nd mora of はこ 'box', not the topic particle, and the following この token is really こ (end of はこ) + genitive の. Split must be この｜はこ｜の｜外｜は…
findings.current: tokens: この｜は (r: わ, particle)｜この (demonstrativo)｜外…
findings.suggested: resegmentar: この｜はこ (箱, 'caixa')｜の (genitivo)｜外｜は…

findings.issue: Standalone 中 'the inside (of the box)' is read なか; ちゅう is the on-reading used only in compounds/suffixes, not for the bare noun contrasted with 外 (そと).

False grammar claim: says a 'この は probably truncated' appears at the start. Nothing is truncated — このはこの is この箱の ('of this box'): はこ = 箱 in hiragana + genitive の. Also inconsistent with expl_pt, which gives a different (equally wrong) parse.
findings.current: Note: at the start appears a この は probably truncated, but the reading is 'this box'.
findings.suggested: Note: このはこの is この箱(はこ)の — 'of this box': はこ (box) written in hiragana, followed by genitive の.

findings.issue: False grammar claim: says このは = この箱は with は marking topic. Actually このはこ = この箱 and the following の is the genitive ('desta caixa'); the clause-1 topic は comes only after 外. Teaches a wrong parse of the sentence.
findings.current: No início, このは corresponde a この箱は ('quanto a esta caixa'), com は marcando o tópico.
findings.suggested: No início, このはこの corresponde a この箱の ('desta caixa'): はこ é 箱 (caixa) em hiragana, seguido do の genitivo.

findings.issue: Literal mirror built on the misparse: spurious leading 'As for this,' — この directly modifies はこ (box); there is no initial topic phrase in the Japanese.
findings.current: As for this, the outside of this box (is) green, but the inside (is) red.
findings.suggested: The outside of this box (is) green, but the inside (is) red.

findings.issue: Same misparse: spurious 'Quanto a esta (caixa),' duplicates この as an extra topic. Structure is この箱の外は…中は… (genitive, then two contrasted topics).
findings.current: Quanto a esta (caixa), quanto ao lado de fora (é) verde, mas quanto ao de dentro (é) vermelho.
findings.suggested: Quanto ao lado de fora desta caixa, (é) verde; mas quanto ao (lado) de dentro, (é) vermelho.

findings.issue: ステレオ rendered as 'This sound' — a calque of pt-BR 'som' (= stereo system). In English 'sound' does not mean the appliance, and a 'sound malfunctioning' is nonsensical; should be 'this stereo'.
findings.current: This sound seems like it's malfunctioning somewhere.
findings.suggested: This stereo seems like it's malfunctioning somewhere.

findings.issue: Under-translation: 金を貸してくれと頼んだ is a quoted request to LEND money. 'He asked for money' drops the loan nuance, clashing with pt ('pediu dinheiro emprestado') and with the dissection built around 貸してくれ.
findings.suggested: He asked me to lend him some money.

findings.issue: 'de entre' is European-Portuguese wording; Brazilian Portuguese uses the contraction 'dentre' (the item's own expl_pt already uses 'dentre todas').
findings.current: Esta televisão, de entre todas, é a número um boa.
findings.suggested: Esta televisão, dentre todas, é a número um boa.
